text: Yes, I can see your screenshots, and they showed the cause: two Claude sessions on the same account were answering at once. Not needed to hand it to Opus: I'm rebuilding the chat myself. Already done: one answer per message, old messages never answered, heartbeat so no extra account is woken. Tennis in live bids is built and tested (on by default now); it ships in the next release together with your stats change, which the other session is doing.
